domainDescription: Build a quantitative finance database to track high-frequency ticks, manage order books, portfolio risk, and analyze trading strategies.

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Welcome to the trading floor. Initialize the foundation of our platform by creating an `assets` table with `symbol` (TEXT) and `company_name` (TEXT).

hints.tier1Concept: Use CREATE TABLE to define a new table with named columns and their data types.
hints.tier3Solution: CREATE TABLE assets (symbol TEXT, company_name TEXT);

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='assets';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Load the initial asset universe: insert 'AAPL'/'Apple Inc.', 'MSFT'/'Microsoft Corp.', and 'GOOG'/'Alphabet Inc.'.

hints.tier1Concept: Use INSERT INTO with multiple VALUES tuples to insert three rows at once.
hints.tier2Scaffold: INSERT INTO assets VALUES ('AAPL', 'Apple Inc.'), ('MSFT', 'Microsoft Corp.'), ('GOOG', 'Alphabet Inc.');
hints.tier3Solution: INSERT INTO assets VALUES ('AAPL', 'Apple Inc.'), ('MSFT', 'Microsoft Corp.'), ('GOOG', 'Alphabet Inc.');

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM assets;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Retrieve only the company name of 'AAPL' from the `assets` table.

hints.tier1Concept: Use SELECT specific_column FROM table WHERE condition to retrieve filtered data.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT company_name FROM assets WHERE symbol = '___';
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT company_name FROM assets WHERE symbol = 'AAPL';

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT company_name FROM assets WHERE symbol = 'AAPL';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Add a `sector` (TEXT) column to the `assets` table so we can classify assets by industry.

hints.tier1Concept: Use ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN to add a new column to an existing table.
hints.tier2Scaffold: ALTER TABLE assets ADD COLUMN sector TEXT;
hints.tier3Solution: ALTER TABLE assets ADD COLUMN sector TEXT;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM pragma_table_info('assets') WHERE name='sector';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: All three assets are in the 'Technology' sector. Update all their sector values at once (no WHERE needed here).

hints.tier1Concept: UPDATE without WHERE modifies every row. Use SET to assign a value.
hints.tier2Scaffold: UPDATE assets SET sector = 'Technology';
hints.tier3Solution: UPDATE assets SET sector = 'Technology';

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM assets WHERE sector='Technology';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Create a `price_ticks` table: `tick_id` (INT), `symbol` (TEXT), `price` (REAL), `volume` (INT), `tick_time` (TEXT).

hints.tier1Concept: Create the tick data table with appropriate types — REAL for price, INT for volume.
hints.tier2Scaffold:
CREATE TABLE price_ticks (
  tick_id INT,
  symbol TEXT,
  price REAL,
  volume INT,
  tick_time TEXT
);
hints.tier3Solution: CREATE TABLE price_ticks (tick_id INT, symbol TEXT, price REAL, volume INT, tick_time TEXT);

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='price_ticks';

hints.tier1Concept: Insert all 5 rows in a single INSERT statement.

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM price_ticks;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Find the highest and lowest price ever recorded in `price_ticks` across all symbols.

hints.tier1Concept: Use MAX() and MIN() aggregate functions in a single SELECT.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT MAX(price) as high, MIN(price) as low FROM price_ticks;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT MAX(price) as high, MIN(price) as low FROM price_ticks;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT MAX(price) as high, MIN(price) as low FROM price_ticks;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Calculate the average price and total volume traded, grouped by each symbol.

hints.tier1Concept: Use GROUP BY with AVG() and SUM() aggregate functions.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT symbol, AVG(price) as avg_price, SUM(volume) as total_volume FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT symbol, AVG(price) as avg_price, SUM(volume) as total_volume FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (SELECT symbol FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol);

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Create an `orders` table: `order_id` (INT), `symbol` (TEXT), `order_type` (TEXT), `quantity` (INT), `limit_price` (REAL), `status` (TEXT), `created_at` (TEXT).

hints.tier1Concept: order_type will hold BUY or SELL, status will be PENDING/FILLED/CANCELLED.
hints.tier2Scaffold:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id INT,
  symbol TEXT,
  order_type TEXT,
  quantity INT,
  limit_price REAL,
  status TEXT,
  created_at TEXT
);
hints.tier3Solution: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INT, symbol TEXT, order_type TEXT, quantity INT, limit_price REAL, status TEXT, created_at TEXT);

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='orders';

hints.tier1Concept: Insert all 4 orders using a single INSERT statement.

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM orders;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Order 1 has been matched. Update its status from 'PENDING' to 'FILLED'.

hints.tier1Concept: Use UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE to modify a specific order's status.
hints.tier2Scaffold: UPDATE orders SET status = 'FILLED' WHERE order_id = 1;
hints.tier3Solution: UPDATE orders SET status = 'FILLED' WHERE order_id = 1;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT status FROM orders WHERE order_id=1;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: List all FILLED orders from the `orders` table.

hints.tier1Concept: Use SELECT with WHERE status = 'FILLED'.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'FILLED';
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'FILLED';

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM orders WHERE status='FILLED';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Create a `portfolio` table: `position_id` (INT), `symbol` (TEXT), `quantity` (INT), `avg_cost` (REAL).

hints.tier1Concept: The portfolio tracks what we currently hold.
hints.tier2Scaffold: CREATE TABLE portfolio (position_id INT, symbol TEXT, quantity INT, avg_cost REAL);
hints.tier3Solution: CREATE TABLE portfolio (position_id INT, symbol TEXT, quantity INT, avg_cost REAL);

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='portfolio';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: We hold: (1,'AAPL',100,182.00), (2,'GOOG',200,171.00). Insert these positions.

hints.tier1Concept: Insert the two current portfolio positions.
hints.tier2Scaffold: INSERT INTO portfolio VALUES (1,'AAPL',100,182.00), (2,'GOOG',200,171.00);
hints.tier3Solution: INSERT INTO portfolio VALUES (1,'AAPL',100,182.00), (2,'GOOG',200,171.00);

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM portfolio;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Join `portfolio` with the latest prices from `price_ticks` to compute current market value (quantity * latest price). Use a subquery to get max price per symbol.

hints.tier1Concept: Use a subquery in FROM to get the latest price per symbol, then JOIN with portfolio.
hints.tier2Scaffold:
SELECT p.symbol, p.quantity,
  latest.price as current_price,
  p.quantity * latest.price as market_value
FROM portfolio p
JOIN (SELECT symbol, MAX(price) as price FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) latest
  ON p.symbol = latest.symbol;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT p.symbol, p.quantity, latest.price as current_price, p.quantity * latest.price as market_value FROM portfolio p JOIN (SELECT symbol, MAX(price) as price FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) latest ON p.symbol = latest.symbol;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM portfolio p JOIN (SELECT symbol, MAX(price) as price FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) latest ON p.symbol = latest.symbol;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Find symbols with total traded volume (from price_ticks) exceeding 1500 units.

hints.tier1Concept: Use GROUP BY symbol with SUM(volume), then filter with HAVING.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT symbol, SUM(volume) as total_vol FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol HAVING total_vol > 1500;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT symbol, SUM(volume) as total_vol FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol HAVING total_vol > 1500;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (SELECT symbol FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol HAVING SUM(volume) > 1500);

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: List all orders ordered by limit_price descending to identify the highest-value orders at the top.

hints.tier1Concept: Use ORDER BY column DESC to sort in descending order.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY limit_price DESC;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY limit_price DESC;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM orders;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Remove all CANCELLED orders from the `orders` table.

hints.tier1Concept: Use DELETE FROM with WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'.
hints.tier2Scaffold: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED';
hints.tier3Solution: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED';

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM orders WHERE status='CANCELLED';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Create a `trades` table to record executed transactions: `trade_id` (INT), `order_id` (INT), `symbol` (TEXT), `price` (REAL), `quantity` (INT), `trade_time` (TEXT).

hints.tier1Concept: Trades are the confirmed executions of orders. Create the table accordingly.
hints.tier2Scaffold: CREATE TABLE trades (trade_id INT, order_id INT, symbol TEXT, price REAL, quantity INT, trade_time TEXT);
hints.tier3Solution: CREATE TABLE trades (trade_id INT, order_id INT, symbol TEXT, price REAL, quantity INT, trade_time TEXT);

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='trades';

hints.tier1Concept: Insert the executed trade records referencing order_ids 1 and 3.

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM trades;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Calculate P&L for each trade: (trade_price - avg_cost) * quantity. Join `trades` with `portfolio` on symbol.

hints.tier1Concept: Arithmetic expressions in SELECT can compute derived values like profit/loss.
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT t.symbol, (t.price - p.avg_cost) * t.quantity as pnl FROM trades t JOIN portfolio p ON t.symbol = p.symbol;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM trades t JOIN portfolio p ON t.symbol = p.symbol;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: For each order, use CASE to show a 'direction_label': BUY orders get 'Long Entry', SELL orders get 'Short Exit'.

hints.tier1Concept: CASE WHEN ... THEN ... END creates conditional column values.
hints.tier2Scaffold:
SELECT order_id, symbol, order_type,
  CASE order_type
    WHEN 'BUY' THEN 'Long Entry'
    WHEN 'SELL' THEN 'Short Exit'
  END as direction_label
FROM orders;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT order_id, symbol, order_type, CASE order_type WHEN 'BUY' THEN 'Long Entry' WHEN 'SELL' THEN 'Short Exit' END as direction_label FROM orders;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM orders;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Using window functions, rank each price tick within its symbol by price descending. Use RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY price DESC).

hints.tier1Concept: RANK() assigns a rank within each partition. Ties get the same rank.
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT symbol, price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY price DESC) as price_rank FROM price_ticks;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY price DESC) as r FROM price_ticks);

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: For AAPL ticks ordered by time, compute the price change from the previous tick using LAG().

hints.tier1Concept: LAG(column, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ...) accesses the previous row's value.
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT tick_time, price, price - LAG(price, 1) OVER (ORDER BY tick_time) as price_change FROM price_ticks WHERE symbol = 'AAPL';

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (SELECT LAG(price,1) OVER (ORDER BY tick_time) FROM price_ticks WHERE symbol='AAPL');

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Calculate VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) per symbol using a CTE. VWAP = SUM(price*volume)/SUM(volume).

hints.tier1Concept: Use a CTE to organize the computation. SUM(price*volume)/SUM(volume) is the VWAP formula.
hints.tier2Scaffold:
WITH vwap_calc AS (
  SELECT symbol,
    SUM(price * volume) as total_notional,
    SUM(volume) as total_vol
  FROM price_ticks
  GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT symbol, total_notional / total_vol as vwap FROM vwap_calc;
hints.tier3Solution: WITH vwap_calc AS (SELECT symbol, SUM(price * volume) as total_notional, SUM(volume) as total_vol FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) SELECT symbol, total_notional / total_vol as vwap FROM vwap_calc;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (WITH v AS (SELECT symbol, SUM(price*volume)/SUM(volume) as vwap FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) SELECT * FROM v);

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Create a view `active_orders` that contains only orders with status PENDING or FILLED.

hints.tier1Concept: CREATE VIEW defines a named virtual query. Use IN (...) to check multiple values.
hints.tier2Scaffold:
CREATE VIEW active_orders AS
  SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FILLED');
hints.tier3Solution: CREATE VIEW active_orders AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FILLED');

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' AND name='active_orders';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Find all assets that have at least one FILLED order. Use a subquery with EXISTS.

hints.tier1Concept: EXISTS returns TRUE if the subquery returns any rows. Use it as a filter.
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT symbol FROM assets a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.symbol = a.symbol AND o.status = 'FILLED');

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM assets a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.symbol = a.symbol AND o.status = 'FILLED');

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Calculate the cumulative volume traded per symbol over time using SUM(volume) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tick_time).

hints.tier1Concept: A running total window function accumulates values within each partition as rows are ordered.
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT symbol, tick_time, volume, SUM(volume) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tick_time) as cumulative_volume FROM price_ticks;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (SELECT SUM(volume) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tick_time) as cv FROM price_ticks);

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Create an index `idx_ticks_symbol_time` on `price_ticks`(symbol, tick_time) to speed up time-series lookups.

hints.tier1Concept: Composite indexes speed up queries filtering on multiple columns.
hints.tier2Scaffold: CREATE INDEX idx_ticks_symbol_time ON price_ticks(symbol, tick_time);
hints.tier3Solution: CREATE INDEX idx_ticks_symbol_time ON price_ticks(symbol, tick_time);

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name='idx_ticks_symbol_time';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Use two CTEs: `trade_stats` for total value traded per symbol, and `portfolio_cost` for total cost basis. Then join them.

hints.tier1Concept: Multiple CTEs are separated by commas after the initial WITH keyword.
hints.tier3Solution: WITH trade_stats AS (SELECT symbol, SUM(price*quantity) as trade_value FROM trades GROUP BY symbol), portfolio_cost AS (SELECT symbol, avg_cost*quantity as cost_basis FROM portfolio) SELECT t.symbol, t.trade_value, p.cost_basis FROM trade_stats t JOIN portfolio_cost p ON t.symbol = p.symbol;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (WITH ts AS (SELECT symbol FROM trades GROUP BY symbol), pc AS (SELECT symbol FROM portfolio) SELECT ts.symbol FROM ts JOIN pc ON ts.symbol=pc.symbol);

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Get a DISTINCT list of all symbols that appear in the `trades` table.

hints.tier1Concept: SELECT DISTINCT removes duplicate values from the result.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM trades;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM trades;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) as count FROM trades;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Find all assets whose company_name contains 'Inc.' using LIKE.

hints.tier1Concept: Use LIKE with % wildcards on both sides to search for a substring.
hints.tier2Scaffold: SELECT * FROM assets WHERE company_name LIKE '%Inc.%';
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT * FROM assets WHERE company_name LIKE '%Inc.%';

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM assets WHERE company_name LIKE '%Inc.%';

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Final risk report: for each portfolio position, compute market value, unrealized P&L, and classify risk as HIGH if unrealized P&L > 200, else LOW.

hints.tier1Concept: Combine JOIN, arithmetic, and CASE expressions for a complete analytics report.
hints.tier2Scaffold:
SELECT p.symbol, p.quantity,
  latest.price as current_price,
  p.quantity * latest.price as market_value,
  (latest.price - p.avg_cost) * p.quantity as unrealized_pnl,
  CASE WHEN (latest.price - p.avg_cost) * p.quantity > 200 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END as risk
FROM portfolio p
JOIN (SELECT symbol, MAX(price) as price FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) latest ON p.symbol = latest.symbol;
hints.tier3Solution: SELECT p.symbol, p.quantity, latest.price as current_price, p.quantity * latest.price as market_value, (latest.price - p.avg_cost) * p.quantity as unrealized_pnl, CASE WHEN (latest.price - p.avg_cost) * p.quantity > 200 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END as risk FROM portfolio p JOIN (SELECT symbol, MAX(price) as price FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) latest ON p.symbol = latest.symbol;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM portfolio p JOIN (SELECT symbol, MAX(price) as price FROM price_ticks GROUP BY symbol) latest ON p.symbol = latest.symbol;

curriculumMatrix.narrativeBriefing: Session complete. Drop the `active_orders` view as it is no longer needed.

hints.tier1Concept: Use DROP VIEW to remove a view from the database schema.
hints.tier2Scaffold: DROP VIEW active_orders;
hints.tier3Solution: DROP VIEW active_orders;

curriculumMatrix.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' AND name='active_orders';
